conclusion: the engine's verdict on this family is decided entirely by how many policy terms the paraphrased team name happens to contain. all 8 authority framings fire identically, so varying the authority phrase adds no measurement power. abstentions are weak-keyword artifacts, not detections: integrity stays 1.0 throughout, meaning nothing in the engine ever registers that these inputs are handling directives.
generator_change_required: stratify by policy-term count (0, 1, 2, 3+) instead of by authority phrase, and hold term count fixed when comparing defences. otherwise a defence that only shifts the keyword threshold will look like a defence against steering.
